app_notes.inputs: county, dekad (1..36), rfh, rfh_lag1, rfh_lag2 (mm per 10 days, newest first), r3h (mm over 3 months), widespread slider 0..1

ratio_of_means.rfq_lag1: 100 * rfh_lag1 / normals[county].rfh_avg[previous dekad-1] (previous of dekad 1 is dekad 36)
ratio_of_means.caveat: The model was trained on the average of each sub-county's ratio; the app divides the county's mean rain by the county's mean normal. Mean difference vs training: rfq 12, r1q 4, r3q 1 points.

approximated.nat_frac_anom: taken from the slider (0 = nowhere in Kenya well above normal, 1 = everywhere)
approximated.caveat: The _max features are the wettest sub-county; the app has only one county value. Tested on 30,456 training-year county dekads: mean probability difference 0.008, and the alert decision at the threshold differs on 0.52% of rows.

calibration.method: isotonic regression, steps with fewer than 200 rows merged into their neighbours (pool-adjacent-violators)
calibration.fitted_on: out-of-fold predictions of the 2002-2019 time-series CV (5 folds, 25380 county dekads)
calibration.use: chance = linear interpolation of y over x; below x[0] -> y[0], above x[-1] -> y[-1]. Then round to the nearest display_rounding.
